arStrings.szText: Hitting enemies with a {c_important}Core{/c} Skill increases the damage they take from you by {c_random}[Affix_Value_1*100|%x|]{/c} per Skill, up to {c_random}[Affix."Static Value 0"*Affix_Value_1*100|%x|]{/c}. {c_important}Archfiend{/c} {c_important}{u}Demonform{/u}{/c} Skill Variants are {c_important}Core{/c} Skills and cost Wrath.
